defs.def: to tell sb that you will definitely do or not do sth, or that sth will definitely happen 许诺；承诺；答应；保证

ex.s: Four days later, when I was back in Vienna, I called Gunter as promised.
ex.t: 四天后，我回到维也纳，如约给冈特打了电话。

ex.s: Four days later, when I was back in Vienna, I called Gunter as promised.
ex.t: 四天后，我回到维也纳，如约给冈特打了电话。

ex.s: I promised to take care of Tiffy and _____52_____ them as soon as we got to Kansas City.
ex.t: 我答应会照顾好蒂菲，并一到堪萨斯城就_____52_____他们。

ex.s: They promised to fix the window.
ex.t: 他们承诺修好窗户。

ex.s: When I applied to graduate school, I found three programmes promising to allow me to follow my desired research direction.
ex.t: 当我申请研究生院时，我发现有三个项目承诺允许我按照自己期望的研究方向发展。

ex.s: I promise not to let it go to my head.
ex.t: 我保证不会让它冲昏头脑。

ex.s: On a website called No Fly Climate Sci, for example, _____40_____（rough） 200 academics - many of them climate scientists ____41____ （promise） to fly as little as possible since the effort started two years ago.
ex.t: 例如，在一个名为No Fly Climate Sci的网站上，（第40空，rough）200名学者——其中许多是气候科学家——自两年前该行动开始以来（第41空，promise）尽可能少飞。

ex.s: They represent the promise of spring and a renewal of life.
ex.t: 它们代表着春天的承诺与生命的更新。

ex.s: The promise and danger of true A GI are great.
ex.t: 真正AGI的潜力与危险都很大。

ex.s: Russia is another country with population problems that could break its economic promise.
ex.t: 俄罗斯是另一个可能因人口问题而无法实现经济承诺的国家。

ex.s: If you’re willing to drive a little further, the Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles promises luxurious rooms and extensive leisure facilities — perfect for turning a game day into a great weekend escape.
ex.t: 如果你愿意开得稍远一点，洛杉矶丽思卡尔顿酒店承诺提供豪华客房和丰富的休闲设施——非常适合把比赛日变成一次很棒的周末出游。

ex.s: He worries that researchers are making promises they can’t keep.
ex.t: 他担心研究人员做出了他们无法兑现的承诺。

ex.s: If researchers can’t keep their promises, excitement might give way to doubt, disappointment and anger, Johnson warns.
ex.t: 如果研究人员不能信守承诺，兴奋可能会转变为怀疑、失望和愤怒，Johnson警告道。

ex.s: They had been promised money by family and friends for each day spent without using social media.
ex.t: 家人和朋友承诺他们每度过一天不使用社交媒体的日子就给他们钱。

ex.s: Tech-Hub remains thankful to the community and promises 5___________________ of our success with the town.
ex.t: 科技中心仍然感谢社区，并承诺5___________________ 与城镇分享我们的成功。

ex.s: I ought to give you a job, as I promised.
ex.t: 我应该给你一份工作，是我答应过的。

ex.s: From their research, they discovered and tested 380 distinct ancient Chinese medical treatments that showed promise in the fight against malaria.
ex.t: 通过研究，他们发现并测试了380种独特的中国古代疗法，这些疗法在抗击疟疾方面显示出了希望。

defs.def: to make sth seem likely to happen; to show signs of sth 使很可能；预示

ex.s: Other cattlemen see more promise in robots.
ex.t: 俄克拉荷马养牛人协会副主席迈克尔·凯尔西·帕里斯表示，鉴于人们对偷牛的担忧日益增加，机器人可能非常有用。

ex.s: With environmentalist Éanna Lamhna as the guide, this walk promises to be an informative tour.
ex.t: 由环保人士Éanna Lamhna担任向导，这次徒步将是一场增长见闻的游览。

defs.def: a statement that tells sb that you will definitely do or not do sth 诺言；许诺；承诺

ex.s: Stick to a promise.
ex.t: 信守诺言。

ex.s: Even as a young boy, da Vinci showed promise as an artist.
ex.t: 即使在小时候，达\u00b7芬奇就已经展现出了艺术家的潜力。

defs.def: a sign that sb/sth will be successful 获得成功的迹象
a sign, or a reason for hope that sth may happen, especially sth good 吉兆；迹象
